messages:
alice: seeing a spike in TLS handshake times from services in ap-southeast-1 since ~08:15 UTC. CPU fine, but a bunch of handshakes are hitting 500ms+ and causing grpc client retries.
ben: ugh — do you have a sample flow? client -> envoy -> service?
alice: yes, client -> envoy sidecar -> internal proxy -> backend. Problems start during certificate validation step. tcp captures show long pauses before CertificateRequest/CertificateVerify.
carol: any correlation with KMS or cert issuance?
dave: KMS is healthy in ap-southeast-1 per our dashboard, but we had a short latency tail around 08:10. Could be unrelated.
alice: logs show a lot of `OCSP responder` lookups timing out. example from envoy: `ocsp check: timeout after 4s` then fallback but that blocks handshake.
eve: are we stapling OCSP responses at our terminators? we intended stapling for edge only.
ben: internal services do full chain validation against public CA by default. some of our proxies perform online OCSP checks (not stapled).
carol: that matches — apac egress to ocsp.example-ca.com had intermittent packet loss earlier (netops alerted). if OCSP lookup blocks, handshake stalls.
alice: reproducer: `openssl s_client -connect svc.internal:443 -status`
```
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=2 C = US, O = ExampleCA
OCSP response: no response sent
---
```
carol: thanks — that `no response sent` indicates no stapled value and remote OCSP unresponsive. we should avoid blocking handshakes on OCSP for internal-mtls by setting a short OCSP timeout and caching responses.
dave: two quick mitigation options: 1) add a local OCSP cache/responder in each region, 2) allow cached-successful-handshake for `tls.mode=internal` for X minutes. will need RBAC for whoever runs the local OCSP proxy to fetch responses from CA.
ben: also we saw some missing audit events: `tls.handshake.*` entries not emitted for those failed attempts in apac — audit logging pipeline dropped events due to flood. we need to keep at least 7 days of raw handshake failures.
alice: creating a runbook patch: short-term -> increase OCSP timeouts? or decrease? we want handshakes to fail fast to let app-level retries handle it. propose set ocsp_timeout=300ms and enable stale-ok cache for 5m.
carol: agree set to 300ms. also add an egress rule exception so local ocsp proxy can reach CA (requires RBAC update in control-plane).
dave: RBAC ask: need `role:ocsp-fetcher` bound to service account `infra-ocsp` in ap-southeast and ap-northeast. who can approve? @eve?
eve: I can approve for ap-southeast only. need justification and audit log entries showing who approves. please add a brief PR in infra-roles repo.
ben: created draft infra-roles PR: `grant infra-ocsp role in ap-southeast` — link: https://git.redwood/infra/roles/pull/432
alice: also note KMS: if we run a local OCSP signer that signs short-lived certs, KMS decrypt/sign latency could be a bottleneck. dave can you add KMS latency SLO alert to the flow?
dave: putting a KMS tail-latency alert on the sign path for ocsp-cache with 95th > 200ms. will add a metric `kms.ocsp_sign_latency_ms` and hook to pager.
carol: temporary mitigation rolling plan: 1) deploy ocsp cache proxy in ap-southeast replicas (canary), 2) update envoy config to use ocsp_timeout=300ms and stale_ok=300s, 3) update RBAC (infra-ocsp role), 4) monitor handshake failure rate and audit log ingestion.
alice: incbot: create incident for this and assign to sec-oncall + infra-oncall
incbot: incident created: INC-2026-187 — title: APAC TLS handshake latency caused by OCSP tail. assignees: sec-oncall, infra-oncall.
eve: prod note: we should also confirm there are no revocation-related CVEs that would require stricter checks. but for internal trust we can relax enforcement temporarily.
dave: I'll also add a short lived KMS policy allowing `infra-ocsp` to call `kms:Sign` only for `ocsp-cache-keys/*` and include audit annotations.\ben: after canary looks good we should push to ap-northeast and eu-west. any objections?
carol: none. let's keep the eu region on alert for 2 hours after rollout.
alice: pf: I'll update runbook with `openssl` checks, envoy config snippet, and the PR links. pushing now.
eve: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
carol: marking this thread for follow-up in 24h with metrics: handshake 95th, audit ingestion rate, kms.ocsp_sign_latency_ms
